subject: Request: temporary invoice-only onboarding for NebulaCorp pilot
messages:

To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Pilot onboarding — request for invoice-only path (short trial)

Hi Aisha,

We loved the demo last week. NebulaCorp wants to run a 6-week pilot with an internal research team starting May 1. Procurement asked if we can onboard under an invoice-only path for the pilot — they can't issue a PO in time because of internal approval cycles.

Can Redwood provide a temporary no-PO onboarding (invoice-only) for a pilot under $8k for the first month? Happy to provide vendor paperwork and evidence.

Attached is our standard vendor intake (fills most fields).

Thanks,
Sophie

NebulaCorp

Hi Sophie — thanks for the form and the quick turnaround. Looping in Marissa (sales) and Laura (finance) to confirm possible temporary onboarding and what evidence we need.

Marissa/Laura — short ask: NebulaCorp requests an invoice-only pilot (no PO) for an initial month under $8k. They can provide the onboarding PDF and a procurement contact. Can finance approve a temporary vendor code + invoice-only route while they finish internal PO approvals? If yes, what evidence do we need and any contract addendum?

I'll wait to consolidate next steps before sending formal confirmation.

Best,
Aisha
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 08:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for invoice-only path (short trial)

Thanks for the ping. Finance can make a one-time exception for invoice-only onboarding under these conditions:

- Pilot not to exceed $10k in billed amount for the first 30 days (we can set a $10k cap instead of $8k).
- Nebula must provide: completed onboarding form, a W-9 or EU equivalent for their entity, and a named procurement approver (email) who confirms timing for a PO.
- We add an addendum to the master terms specifying temporary invoice-only routing and automatic conversion to PO billing after the pilot.

If they can provide the three items above by Apr 20, we can issue a temporary vendor code and route invoices to finance for payment. I'll also need the internal business justification and expected billing cadence.

I've attached a short checklist for the evidence we need.

Laura
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: procurement_evidence_checklist.xlsx (xlsx)]
